desc: Identify a range-update sweep strategy for optimizing the two split positions.
Derive the exact invariant and previous-occurrence update range for the left-to-right sweep.
Design the lazy segment tree with range-add, range-maximum, and invalid-boundary handling.
Precompute prefix and suffix distinct counts and occurrence positions in \(O(N)\).
Validate boundary cases, including non-empty segments, repeated values, and all-equal sequences.
Implement the complete stdin/stdout Python solution in \(O(N\log N)\) time and \(O(N)\) memory.
Run the supplied sample tests and confirm both outputs.
